risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of any brand name/logo and the full part number/label on the alternator housing (front sticker and/or side plate).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used alternator (worst case: not confirmed Valeo/M278-specific).

risks.risk: Wrong application/fitment for Mercedes M278 (different alternator variants by engine/years).
risks.proof: Photo of the alternator part number plate plus a photo of the vehicle VIN/engine code or the seller’s compatibility list (or the exact OE number).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially not the exact match (worst case: may require return/exchange).

risks.risk: Electrical health not confirmed (diodes/regulator/bearings may fail even if windings look intact).
risks.proof: Video or photo of alternator bench test results (output voltage/current) or a test on the vehicle showing charging voltage under load.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair/doesn’t charge).

risks.risk: Pulley/bearing condition (play/noise) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Clip showing the pulley shaft play (hand test) and/or a short spin video with sound; ideally include bearing inspection photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown bearing condition (worst case: bearing replacement may be needed).

Photo of the mounting/connector side with all markings visible (both sides).
Bench test or on-vehicle charging test showing voltage output (with a short video).
Video showing pulley rotation and any shaft play/noise.
